messages:
Aisha: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands fireside — leaving a live thread for any short strategy questions on mission, positioning, roadmap, or competitors. Post brief Qs and we'll answer.
Jules: One-liner for sales: is our claim "predictable inference economics" safe to use?
Aisha: Yes. Use: "Predictable inference economics: reliable latency, transparent unit cost, and safe rollouts."
Marco: Add technical line for buyers: "We optimize kernels, cache prefixes, and route requests to maintain p95 under load."
Sam: Competitors keep lowering hosted list price. Do we need a price change?
Priya: For devs/PLG keep hosted pricing simple. For enterprise emphasize Dedicated + SLAs. We don't race to be lowest list price.
Dana: Roadmap: short version = (1) runtime latency wins, (2) rollout & observability, (3) cost tooling.
Jules: Will sales get a cheat sheet for messaging?
Dana: Yes, one-pager + two templates (dev and enterprise) by end of week. Priya to own copy.
Marco: Engineering note: canary + fallback sprint next week. Config prototype: ``rollout:{canary:0.1,monitor:p95_latency,fallback:small-variant}``.
ops-bot: docs.redwood.ai/runbook/rollouts shared :link:
Aisha: Thanks all — keep follow-ups short, we'll spin up breakouts if needed. Closing in 24h unless new Qs.
Sam: Thanks, helpful.
Priya: On it.
